scope: COV-018q: emphatic time/place compound 에야, explicit 에 + 야 decomposition, and inherited outer 만 without general particle reordering.
source_attribution: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, September 2026 export; all notes/senses and up to two example groups.

senses.definition: 시간이나 공간의 일정한 범위를 강조하여 나타내는 조사.
examples: 김 씨는 십 년 만에야 억울한 누명을 벗을 수 있었다.
유민이는 한참 후에야 내 말을 이해했다는 듯이 빙그레 웃었다.

additional_sources.title: 국어 교과 용어의 수화 표준화 연구: 언어 영역
additional_sources.finding: Explicitly describes 에야 as case particle 에 plus auxiliary particle 야, with time/place emphasis. Text extracted by the web tool; screenshot fetch unavailable.

remaining: Noun POS does not establish time/place semantics; raw unknown-head and nominalization hypotheses remain distinct from contextual correctness.
This decomposition is specific to 에야. Other focus/case orders, free-standing 야 + 만 after arbitrary bases and other compound-particle decompositions remain separate reviews.
Corpus 때+에+야만 and program 때+에+야+만 differ in granularity, without changing source gold; both recover the same lexical group.
Independent Korean-language review and contextual interpretation remain open.
